BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses tsûwth where it means to blaze, to burn. In Isaiah 27:4, I would burn them together.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the blazing of Isaiah 27 is God's anger turned to purpose, burning away what chokes His vineyard.
